lines.t: My dear
I felt the shadow when your pride finally broke
I tasted salt on your cheeks
From tears you could not choke
You thought I stood at distance
I was waiting by the door
The moment your heart cracked open
Love floods the room and fills the floors
All the years you stood off hard
I carried every hand that ached
And now your tears fall free again
Everyone I rushed to take
Let our tears flow, yours are mine
I feel our sorrow and hope combine
Let our tears flow hard tomorrow
What felt like bitter end
Is the sweetest love
Don't let go
My dear home
Just let them flow
I counted every sorrow
I held each wound you hid at night
I see each facet of your soul
Heart softened quickly in my life
Oh, now your heart is open wide
The veil you made is torn
And what was cold and colorless
Now feels the warmth of morn
You ask, can you mend this ruin?
I say I already have begun
For the moment floodgate opens
My love and yours become one
Let our tears flow, yours are mine
Feel our sorrow and hope combine
Let our tears flow heart to heart
What felt like bitter end
Is the sweetest start
Don't let go
You opened what was closed
Now love can breathe again
Your tears became my own
No distance left to mend
Let our tears flow
Beloved one
This is how the two become one
Let our tears flow
Yours are mine
Feel our sorrow and hope combine
Let our tears flow heart to heart
What felt like bitter end
It is the sweetest start
Don't let go
Let them fall, my treasures
Every tear is counted now
Rest your head upon my chest
You are restored, I'll show you how
Our tears flow
Let them flow
Thank you for watching.
